title: Continuity, Events, Advancement, Life/Ecology Change & Resolution Management
objective: Add bounded continuity, event, advancement, life/ecology-change and resolution-management projections for NPC/creature candidates without replacing authoritative event, advancement, world-state, ecology or entity histories.

scope.purpose: Provide continuity-aware proposal/update management over completed MNCS candidate layers while preserving authoritative histories and unresolved-safe change.
scope.completion_gate: NPC/creature continuity, events, advancement and life/ecology changes can be proposed and resolved without duplicating canonical event/history/world-state/ecology ledgers or erasing authoritative history.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-18 publication.
The DAG contains no MNCS-18-triggered rotation or newly eligible unfinished interstitial that overrides MNCS strict order; MNCS-20 is the next unfinished surviving tranche.
Event/history, advancement, world-state, ecology and Character/NPC/Creature owner domains retain canonical authority; MNCS-20 authors projections/resolution proposals only.
Continuity management cannot erase authoritative history, silently rewrite prior accepted facts, or invent unresolved changes.
MNCS-20 absorbs baseline MNCS-20/MNCS-21 plus the documented MNCS-09 continuity projection residual.
MNCS-20 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
The independent ui-implementation lane remains UISR-09 in_progress and player-species remains MVPS-03 selected_not_started; both are preserved unchanged.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in the product-development lane. On that command, governed-start MNCS-20 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MNCS-20 is selected_not_started after fresh post-MNCS-18 DAG/backlog reconciliation; no bounded MNCS-20 execution is active.
